footer.tagline: Studafy runs the school day for staff and families, in English and Arabic.

home.seoTitle: School management in English and Arabic
home.seoDescription: Studafy keeps attendance, timetables, homework, marks, fees and family updates in one system for school staff, parents and students, in English and Arabic.
home.heroTitle: The whole school day, in one system.
home.heroBody: Attendance, timetables, homework, marks, fees and updates for families. Studafy gives each person in the school the part they need, in English and Arabic, on the web and on their phone.
home.dayTitle: A Tuesday at a school on Studafy

late.what: A late arrival corrected, with the reason kept

marks.what: Term marks approved and released to families

payment.what: A fee instalment recorded against an invoice

home.what: Today's attendance and homework checked at home

study.what: Quiz on today's lesson, made from the class's own notes

home.rolesTitle: Every role sees its own part of the school
home.rolesLede: Permissions follow the job. A teacher sees their classes, a parent sees their children, finance sees the accounts, and the school decides who can do what.
home.modulesLede: Each part works from the same students, classes and staff, so nothing is typed twice.

academics.title: Academics and timetable
academics.body: Years, terms, subjects and classes, and a timetable built for each term.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: A register for every lesson, corrections with a reason, and reports for the attendance office.

homework.title: Homework
homework.body: Assignments with due dates, work handed in from the phone, and marking.

exams.title: Exams and marks
exams.body: Your school's own exam structure and weights, mark entry, and approval before release.

finance.title: Fees and finance
finance.body: Fee plans, instalments, invoices, payments, refunds and VAT, with one account per family.

families.title: Families
families.body: Every child in a family under one account, with the notifications each parent chooses.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.body: To the whole school, one role or one class, sent now or scheduled for later.

discipline.title: Discipline and evaluations
discipline.body: Incidents, the actions taken, and staff evaluations, kept on the record.

records.title: School records and lists
records.body: The details your school collects on students, parents, staff and classes, and lists for anything else.

imports.title: Imports
imports.body: Students, staff and classes brought in from a spreadsheet, with every change checked before it is saved.

home.languageBody: Every screen works in both languages, with a right-to-left layout in Arabic. Each person picks their own language, so a teacher can work in English while a parent reads in Arabic.
home.languageCaption: The same words, as each person sees them

separate.title: Each school's data stays separate
separate.body: Schools never see each other's records, and the database enforces it, not only the app.

sensitive.title: Sensitive details stay hidden
sensitive.body: ID numbers and medical notes are encrypted and hidden by default, and each time someone opens one is recorded.

history.title: Changes leave a trail
history.body: Corrections to marks, attendance and fees record who made them and when.

requests.title: People can ask for their data
requests.body: Staff and families can ask for a copy of their data or for it to be deleted, and the school can act on it.

home.pricingBody: Every school gets all of Studafy at no cost. Students can add the AI study assistant for themselves if they want it.
home.closingBody: Tell us about your school. We'll show you around and help you set it up.
home.registerTitle: Take the register. Watch the school hear about it.
home.registerLede: Mark a student late or absent. Their parent hears about it straight away, and the attendance office's numbers move with it. Try it.

mobileOnly.message: Students, parents, teachers and attendance officers sign in on the Studafy mobile app. The website is for school administrators, principals and finance staff.

ai.title: AI Study Assistant
ai.intro: A personal AI tutor built on the student's own class materials: ask anything, practice with quizzes and flashcards, and get quick summaries.
ai.confirmPrice: You'll confirm the price on the next, secure step before anything is charged.
